subject: Missing invoice VEN027-0021 in GSTR-2B
body:
Dear Bharat Traders Private Limited team,

We are reconciling our purchases and note that invoice VEN027-0021 dated 27 Sep 2025 is not shown in your GSTR-2B for Sep 2025 or the following month. Rs 5,296 of input tax credit is at risk.

Please report the invoice in your return and confirm once it appears. We will hold the credit note until then.

Accounts team
Sharma Traders Pvt Ltd
